'''Barrage''' is a ranged [[attack]] [[skill]] that fires all of your [[bow]] or [[wand]] projectiles rapidly in succession.

==Skill functions and interactions==

* '''Attack time vs projectile count''': Barrage fires 5 projectiles by default, and can be increased through various modifiers. 40% of the attack time is spent winding up, and the remaining 60% of the attack time is distributed equally between each fired projectile.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/4e97y1/psa_barrage_mechanics_ggget_confirmed_statement/</ref> Additional projectiles will reduce the time between each fired projectile and increase the number of hits per second, but has no impact on the overall attack time.
* '''{{il|Volley Support}}''': Linking Barrage to {{il|Volley Support}} or {{il|Greater Volley Support}} will cause the arrows to instead fire in sequence in a near-parallel volley, from the leftmost to rightmost firing point.
* '''Randomised spread''': By default, projectiles from Barrage spread over a small angle of approximately 20 degrees. Allocating {{psl|Far Shot}} causes Barrage to have no spread.
* '''[[Dual wielding]]''': Each use of Barrage will alternate [[wand]]s if dual-wielding.
* '''[[Trigger]]s''': Barrage cannot be triggered by effects such as [[Snipe]] and {{il|Maloney's Mechanism}}.<ref>{{cite web
| author = Jatin_GGG
| date = Apr 18, 2019
| title = Maloney's Mechanism can't trigger barrage.
| url = https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2490586
}}</ref>
* '''{{il|Volley Fire}}''': Volley fires the first and last projectiles in the sequence to also fire 3 additional projectiles on either side in an arc. These projectiles cannot hit the same target as the main projectile.
* Because '''Barrage''' fires a flat number of arrows instead of one plus a number of '''Additional Arrows''' {{il|Fury Valve}} will not modify the base number of projectiles Barrage fires.  Each projectile fired will still split off two arrows to hit additional targets, and any sources of '''Additional Projectiles''' such as {{il|Lesser Multiple Projectiles Support}} will be applied to the number of arrows that split, not the base number of arrows the skill fires.  In other words, 0% quality Barrage linked with Lesser Multiple Projectiles will shoot 7 arrows while adding Fury Valve will result in Barrage firing the base 5 projectiles which then split off to hit up to an additional '''20''' (5 * (2 + 2)) targets.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.29.0|
* Barrage: Now fires 6 Projectiles (previously 5).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.27.0|
* Barrage: Attack Speed is now 115% of base (previously 100%), and has a Mana Cost of 5-9 at gem levels 1-20 (previously 6-10).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
*  Now has a Mana cost of 6 at gem level 1 (previously 7), scaling up to 10 at gem level 20 (previously 11).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* Quality now causes the skill to Fire +0-1 Projectile, instead of providing 0-10% increased Projectile Damage.
* Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some.
* Transfigured Gems are alternate versions of existing skill gems that have different functionality and balance than their regular versions. We have added many of these, with interesting variations that drastically change how existing skills play.
* Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem.
* Many Skill Gems now display the total number of projectiles or arrows they fire, instead of how many additional ones.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.15.0|
* Now deals 47% of base Attack Damage at gem level 1 (previously 40%), up to 54.6% of base Attack Damage at gem level 20 (previously 47.6%).
* Now has 47% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 40%), up to 54.6% at gem level 20 (previously 48%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.12.0|
* Now has alternative gem quality:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2936122|title=Alternate Quality Gems in Path of Exile: Heist|date=September 17, 2020|accessdate=December 1, 2023|author=Bex_GGG|publisher=Path of Exile Forums}}</ref>
:{{c|gem|Anomalous}}: {{c|mod|1% chance to Knock Enemies Back on hit}} (per 1% quality)
:{{c|gem|Divergent}}: {{c|mod|0.5% increased Attack Speed}} (per 1% quality)
:{{c|gem|Phantasmal}}: {{c|mod|Inflict non-Damaging Ailments as though dealing 5% more Damage}} (per 1% quality)
}}
{{Version history table row|3.11.0|
* Fixed a bug where the Barrage effect, when used by a [[mines|mine]], faced the wrong direction.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.9.0|
* A lot of ranged attack skills have received major visual improvements, including the basic wand and bow attacks, {{il|Burning Arrow}}, Barrage and {{il|Puncture}}.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.3.0|
* Now has an added damage effectiveness and base damage of 40% at gem level 1 (down from 50%), up to 47.6% at gem level 20 (down from 61.4%).
* Now fires 4 additional projectiles (up from 3).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.1.0|
* The helmet enchantment which grants additional projectiles for Barrage has been removed from the Merciless Labyrinth. The Eternal Labyrinth Barrage enchantment now grants one additional projectile (down from 2).
}}
{{Version history table row|2.1.0|
* Barrage damage has been increased from 40% to 50% of base damage at level one. At level 20, it now has been increased from dealing 47.6% to 61.4% of base damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.0.0|
* Instead of gaining 4% increased Physical Damage per level, Barrage now gains 0.4% Base Damage per level.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.1.0|
* The 33% less attack speed penalty has been removed from Barrage.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.4|
* The Barrage skill has been added for the Ranger in Descent Champions.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.3|
* Barrage has been added to the game.
}}
